summary:
Daily digest, session of 2026-10-28: U.S. equity ETFs closed modestly higher. SPY rose 0.18%, DIA gained 0.21%, and QQQ added 0.09%, while IWM slipped 0.03%. Energy led sectors, with XLE up 0.99% as USO rose 3.14%. Technology (XLK, +0.30%) and health care (XLV, +0.36%) also advanced, while real estate (XLRE, -0.98%) and communication services (XLC, -0.44%) lagged. Long Treasuries (TLT) fell 0.45%, gold (GLD) dropped 0.53%, and the dollar (UUP) eased 0.07%.

Among eligible stocks, GMAB led gainers at +29.5%, followed by AXGN (+28.1%) and KIDS (+23.0%). BCAX posted the steepest decline, down 47.3%, with OTLY and MTLS also sharply lower.

In news, Amazon (AMZN) was the most-mentioned ticker ahead of its Q3 earnings, with coverage centered on AWS growth, device-unit job cuts, and new Echo products. Vertiv (VRT) rose 14% after orders more than doubled.
